content.title: Broadwood slams STAAR board over “carelessness” in Alcon sale defense
content.summary: Investing.com — STAAR Surgical’s (NASDAQ:STAA) largest shareholder, Broadwood Partners, has renewed its criticism of the company’s board ahead of the October 23 vote on its $28-per-share sale to Alcon (NYSE:ALC), accusing directors of “carelessness” after a new proxy report suggested they may have approved the deal without full information.
